newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends little changed, ignores NY rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends little changed, ignores NY rally.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures shrugged off the rally in the New York arabicas market with price movements tightly pinned in ranges of around $30 on the nearby contracts.
Although September arabicas jumped through resistnace at 198.00 cents/lb to peak at 203.00, the London market was reluctant to show much of a reaction and was content to meander in listless trade.
"It's very quiet, there's not much going on," said one trader, adding that even arbitrage interest was thin.
At the close benchmark September stood down $5 at $1,655 of the four positions traded. November was unchanged and also stood at $1,655.
Earlier, traders said a lack of demand from roasters combined with Europe's August holiday period were reducing activity on the London market.
There was little fundamental news of note, although independent forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said cooler air remained to the south of Brazil's coffee belt.
But did not strong enough to cause any damaging cold as it moved toward the region, WSC said.
